title: Mexico City Romantic Food Trail: 3 Nights of Flavors, Markets & Mezcal
description: A romantic culinary journey through Mexico City's best neighborhoods — from street-side tacos al pastor to candlelit fine dining, bustling markets to hidden mezcalerías. Built for two food lovers who want to taste everything.

days.title: Arrival, Street Tacos & Mezcal
days.description: Dive straight into the heart of CDMX — colonial grandeur, legendary street food, and your first mezcal bar.

activities.name: Arrive & Check In
activities.description: Fly into Mexico City International Airport (MEX) and head to your hotel in Roma Norte or Condesa — the city's most romantic, walkable neighborhoods. Walk through the Zócalo, one of the world's largest public squares. Peek inside the stunning Palacio de Bellas Artes and wander the colonial streets.
details: 💡 Roma Norte hotels: Casa Goliana, Hotel Condesa DF, or Nima Local House
📍 Zócalo metro station drops you right there
🌮 Budget: ~$3-5 USD for a full taco tour
💡 Follow the longest lines — locals know best

activities.name: Mezcal Tasting at Bósforo
activities.description: A tiny, candlelit mezcal bar tucked in Centro Histórico. Perfect for couples — intimate, smoky, and utterly romantic. Try a flight of 3 artisanal mezcals.

days.title: Markets, Fine Dining & Rooftop Romance
days.description: From exotic ingredients at San Juan market to a world-class tasting menu at Pujol — today is the culinary peak.

activities.name: Mercado de San Juan
activities.description: Mexico City's gourmet market where chefs shop. Sample exotic meats (crocodile, wild boar), imported cheeses, fresh seafood cocktails, and artisanal mole. A foodie paradise. A CDMX institution since 1935. Crispy churros dipped in thick Mexican hot chocolate — the perfect mid-morning romantic snack.
details: 💡 Try a seafood cocktail at Marisquería La Sirena

activities.name: Stroll Condesa & Roma
activities.description: Wander the tree-lined streets of these twin neighborhoods. Browse boutiques on Álvaro Obregón, sit in Parque México, admire the Art Deco architecture. Pure romantic wandering. One of CDMX's best specialty coffee shops, nestled in Coyoacán-adjacent Condesa. Single-origin Mexican beans roasted in-house.
details: 🌳 Parque México is gorgeous for a couple's stroll
📍 Álvaro Obregón for coffee shops and galleries

days.title: Floating Gardens & Bohemian Charm
days.description: Escape the city on a colorful trajinera through Xochimilco's canals, then explore the cobblestone streets of Coyoacán.

activities.name: Xochimilco Floating Gardens
activities.description: Board a colorful trajinera (flat-bottomed boat) and float through the ancient Aztec canals. Food vendors paddle up selling elote, tamales, and micheladas. Hire a mariachi boat for extra romance.
details: 💡 Bring your own drinks and snacks — it's allowed and encouraged

activities.name: Explore Coyoacán
activities.description: Wander the cobblestone streets of this bohemian neighborhood. Visit the Frida Kahlo Museum (Casa Azul), browse the artisan market in Jardín Centenario, and soak up the village-within-a-city atmosphere. Duck into the neighborhood market for legendary tostadas de tinga and fresh-squeezed juices. Casual, cheap, and delicious — quintessential CDMX eating.
details: 🎟️ Frida Kahlo Museum: ~$13 USD — book online in advance!
📍 Jardín Centenario for people-watching and ice cream

activities.name: Sunset Rooftop Drinks
activities.description: Head back to Roma/Condesa for golden-hour cocktails on a rooftop terrace. Sip mezcal negronis as the city lights up below.
details: 📍 Try Terraza Cha Cha Chá or Hotel Condesa DF rooftop

days.title: Last Bites & Departure
days.description: One final morning to savor Mexico City before heading home.

activities.name: Chilaquiles Breakfast at Lalo!
activities.description: End the trip right with the city's best chilaquiles — crispy tortilla chips drenched in salsa verde, topped with crema, queso fresco, and a fried egg. Worth the wait. Grab a last café de olla (cinnamon-spiced coffee) from Churrería El Moro or a specialty espresso from Buna, then head to the airport with a full heart and fuller stomach.
details: ✈️ Allow 1-1.5 hours to reach MEX airport from Roma
